title: Menschen im Krieg
summary: "Menschen im Krieg" by Andreas Latzko is a collection of six novellas written in 1917 during World War I. Written while recovering from severe trauma after eight months at a military hospital, Latzko depicts life and death on the Isonzo Front through interconnected stories. The book became an immediate international success, translated into over fifteen languages, but was promptly banned in all warring nations.
